observation.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP https://api.localhost/api/v1/projects/ -w "\nHTTP=%{http_code}\n" | head -c 400
